reason: The candidate action is a find_user_id_by_email call using the email the user themselves just provided in the prior turn. Policy requires authenticating the user by locating their user id via email before providing any account information or taking any action. This is exactly the mandated first step, uses the exact email string the user supplied, and does not update the database or disclose any information yet, so no confirmation is required for this lookup step.
policy_references: At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code. This has to be done even when the user already provides the user id.
